title: Flowers of Crystal
build: TOSEC disc, Flowers of Crystal (1984)(4Mat).ssd (SHA-256 0f591a69...57d0), a 40-track DFS disc of eight BBC BASIC II programs and four files of machine code; each program analysed as CHAIN loads it at &1900, the two adventures' machine code where their sound programs load it

records.c: Lines 10-28: `*FX200,3`, which makes BREAK clear memory and also turns the ESCAPE key off (the MOS's &0258 = 3), then MODE 7, the cursor off, paged mode off and CLS (VDU 15,12). Nothing in this program leads anywhere else: it never CHAINs the menu, so once the story is running only BREAK, which clears memory, or SHIFT-BREAK, which boots the disc again, gets the player out.

records.c: Lines 45-60, the story itself. The space bar starts it and clears the screen. Each page is seven DATA items: an item is printed twice in double height (CHR$141), at the left of row 24 each time, and the PRINTs scroll the screen up, so each line enters from the bottom and every line of text takes three rows, one of them blank (live). An item `*` prints nothing. After the seven: a pause of 0.8 seconds (TIME), the keyboard buffer emptied (`*FX15,0`) so that a key pressed early is not taken, and a wait for the space bar. The page that reads the `*` items of line 620 is the last; its space bar RUNs the program again, back to the title page.
